tagline: Link customer feature requests in HubSpot to engineering issues in Linear
metaTitle: HubSpot + Linear Integration: Feature Requests to Issues
metaDescription: Show engineering what customers ask for. GAIA turns HubSpot feature requests into Linear issues and alerts reps when they ship. See the setup steps.
intro:
Sales teams capture customer feature requests in HubSpot notes and deal fields, but those requests rarely reach the engineering team in a structured way. Engineers using Linear have no visibility into which customer asked for a feature or how many deals depend on it. Product decisions get made without the revenue context sitting in the CRM, and customers wait for features without any feedback loop.

GAIA connects the two so customer requests drive engineering priorities with full context attached. When a sales rep logs a feature request, GAIA creates or links an issue with the customer details, deal value, and request frequency. When the engineering team ships the feature, GAIA notifies the account owner in HubSpot so they can update the customer before the customer asks.

This integration is essential for product-led and sales-assisted SaaS companies that want feature development to be informed by real customer demand rather than internal guesswork.

useCases.title: Create Linear issues from HubSpot feature requests
useCases.description: When a sales rep logs a feature request on a deal or contact, GAIA creates a corresponding issue with the request details, customer name, deal value, and request frequency so engineering has full context.

useCases.title: Track request popularity across deals
useCases.description: GAIA aggregates feature request notes across multiple deals and updates an issue's description with a running count of requesting customers and combined deal value, helping engineering prioritize by revenue impact.

useCases.title: Notify account owners when features ship
useCases.description: When an issue linked to a feature request is marked Done, GAIA creates a task for the account owner to reach out to requesting customers, closing the feedback loop before customers follow up.

useCases.title: Link Linear issues to HubSpot deal records
useCases.description: GAIA adds issue links to deal records so account managers can check engineering status on customer-requested features directly from the CRM without needing Linear access.

useCases.title: Escalate high-value feature blockers
useCases.description: When a deal is blocked by a missing feature, GAIA escalates the linked issue with a priority flag and deal value annotation, ensuring engineering leadership sees the revenue at stake.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Linear organization. Configure which properties indicate a feature request and which team should receive the issues.

howItWorks.step: Define request capture and linking rules
howItWorks.description: Set the deal or contact properties that GAIA monitors for feature requests, and configure how it deduplicates requests, creating a new issue or linking to an existing one.

howItWorks.step: GAIA closes the loop between customers and engineering
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors the CRM for new requests and the issue tracker for completions, creating issues, updating request counts, and notifying account owners when requested features are shipped.

faqs.question: Can GAIA deduplicate feature requests from multiple deals?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA matches requests by feature name or description and links multiple records to a single issue, updating it with a count of requesting customers rather than creating duplicates.

faqs.question: Can account managers see Linear issue status from within the CRM?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA adds the issue link and current status to the deal or contact record, so account managers can see whether a feature is backlogged, in progress, or shipped without accessing the issue tracker.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support HubSpot custom properties for feature request tracking?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to read feature request data from any custom property on deal or contact records, not just standard fields, so it fits your existing CRM data model.
